info.title: CopyPaste internal platform core contract
info.description: Versioned contract. Implementation and external verification status are recorded in docs/delivery/02-implementation-ledger.md.

x-contract-scope.covered: Projects, tasks, deliverables, risks/changes, knowledge, contracts, purchases, claims, upload/commit, approval, subscriptions, costs/payments, agent runs/plans and incidents.
extensions-required-before-implementatio: Platform identity binding and independent recovery delivery
Role/policy/member management; workflow and project template publishing
Comments, budget revisions and specialized project closure exceptions
Contract amendment activation, milestone fulfillment and advanced purchase exception rules
Request revision editing and OCR review
Custom subscription cycles, effective cancellation, actual charge confirmation
Counterparty CRUD, report snapshots and exports
Retention, backup, audit, skill publishing and operations

post.summary: Persist an authenticated Telegram update before acknowledging it

200.description: Durably received; does not imply a model run or delivery

get.summary: Read one authenticated bounded byte range from a fixed verified version

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Single closed byte range, at most 32 MiB. Required when the object is larger than 32 MiB.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Optional exact strong ETag returned by a prior response; mismatch is rejected.

200.description: Complete object of at most 32 MiB

get.summary: Read at most 1 MiB as authenticated fixed-version base64 JSON; no cloud URL or redirect

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: 0..1048576 decoded bytes. Zero is allowed only for an empty file at offset zero.

parameters.name: If-Range
parameters.description: Exact quoted SHA-256 of the fixed version. Mismatch is 412; omission is 428.

200.description: Ordered safe company events; private model reasoning excluded.

parameters.name: X-CP-Status-Signature
parameters.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of UTF-8 CP-STATUS-V1\n + canonical lowercase source UUID + \n + exact request bytes. No employee credentials. Max 4096 body bytes.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Configured original currency whose current approved budget forms the fixed baseline.

200.description: Reauthorized UTF-8 CSV; fixed source manifest, no durable server file.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable across retries, scoped to actor and route.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Server requires for every cookie-authenticated write; Bearer-only excluded.

UploadCreate.description: file_id and base_version_id must both be present for an update, both absent for a new file. Max bytes=120000000000.

recheck_at.description: 最迟重新读取时刻；不构成在此之前健康或授权不会变化的保证。
